name: Mayflower Inn & Spa, Auberge Collection
positioning: Country inn in Litchfield County, Connecticut, on 58 acres of gardens and woodland, with a wellbeing retreat and an on-site restaurant
best_for: Travelers who want a countryside getaway two hours from New York City
Families and pet owners, as Condé Nast Traveler describes the resort as family- and pet-friendly

facts.text: The inn is in Litchfield County, Connecticut.
The inn is two hours' drive from New York City.
Common spaces include a yellow parlor room and a quiet library.
A guest room reviewed by Condé Nast Traveler had a canopied king bed, a walk-in closet and a bathroom with a tub and a shower.
The all-day hotel restaurant is called the Tap Room, with a menu by chef April Bloomfield built around garden-fresh produce.
Guests can have s'mores by the fire pits.
The inn has a restaurant called Café Boulud at The Mayflower.
Condé Nast Traveler describes the resort as family- and pet-friendly.
Tennis with a pro is among the experiences listed by the inn.
Experiences on offer include a hot air balloon ride, bike trips and whiskey tastings.

highlights.text: The inn sits on 58 acres of landscaped gardens and woodland in Washington, Connecticut.
The spa house has an indoor pool and a jacuzzi room.
The Retreat at Mayflower Inn is the inn's wellbeing destination, offering bodywork, skin therapies, health coaching and seasonal retreats.
The grounds include a chef's garden and the American Poet's Maze.
The all-day hotel restaurant is called the Tap Room, with a menu by chef April Bloomfield built around garden-fresh produce.

considerations.text: The inn is in the countryside, two hours' drive from New York City.
WhataHotel notes that the rural Connecticut location requires a car to explore the area.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
